systems_found: Colorado State University System (Fort Collins, Pueblo, Global)
Independent publics: Metropolitan State University of Denver, University of Northern Colorado, Colorado School of Mines, Colorado Mesa, Western Colorado, Fort Lewis, Adams State

sources.institution: University of Colorado (all campuses) - Personnel roster PDF
sources.coverage_years: FY2024-25 (snapshot 11/1/2024); earlier years likely under similar /doc/ paths
sources.institutions_covered: CU Boulder, CU Denver, CU Anschutz, UCCS, System Administration
sources.employees: all except temporary, student and part-time retiree employees
sources.blocker: PDF and NO employee names (anonymized roster ID only)
sources.notes: Person-level but de-identified; pay is base only (no bonuses/allowances). Text extracts cleanly with pypdf, one row per line. The companion online 'CU Salary Database' (https://www.cu.edu/budget/cu-salary-database, FY2025-26, updated 4/1/2026) is the same data in a JS viewer; no data URL was found in page source.

sources.institution: Colorado State University (Fort Collins) - Compensation Report
sources.employees: unknown (per CSU, online data omits names and gender)
sources.blocker: Cloudflare returns 403 to scripted requests; page content not visible without JS; CSU says names are excluded online (names only in a printed analysis at Morgan Library)
sources.notes: Fort Collins Coloradoan has published a CSU salary database in its Data Central (without names per CSU letter). Recheck in a browser.

Older CSU-Pueblo 'Staffing Pattern' publications (Colorado State Publications Library, spl.cde.state.co.us/artemis/ucspserials/...) listed named employees with base pay (e.g. 2015, 2020) - historic PDFs, possibly B for history.

sources.institution: Colorado state publications library - historic personnel rosters / staffing patterns
sources.download_url: https://spl.cde.state.co.us/artemis/ (serial PDFs per institution/year, e.g. ucsp1122015internet.pdf, uccs1102014internet.pdf)
sources.blocker: Scattered historic PDFs of varying layout; not verified which include names
sources.notes: Identified via Colorado Virtual Library guide; not opened.

sources.institution: Colorado state employees (Colorado Politics tool / TOP)
sources.institutions_covered: state agencies only; universities and colleges excluded (own payroll)
sources.notes: data.colorado.gov has no employee salary datasets (searched Socrata catalog for 'salary' and 'employee').

private_extra: None found beyond IRS 990s (University of Denver, Colorado College, Regis).
gaps: No named person-level salary data officially published by any Colorado public institution (CU roster is de-identified; CSU omits names online). Nothing found for CCCS, MSU Denver (personnel budgeting page now 403; archive inaccessible), UNC, Mines, Mesa, Western, Fort Lewis, Adams State. Named data requires CORA requests.
notes: Rated CU roster B despite lacking names because it is all-employee, person-level and cleanly parseable. MSU Denver once had a 'personnel budgeting' page (archived 2021) of unknown content. Shared scratchpad venv was deleted mid-run by another process; used a private folder w_ak8.
